ideas.name: Bitcoin Turn-of-the-Candle Effect
ideas.claim: Bitcoin returns were concentrated in the first minute of each 15-minute candle; the paper proposes algorithmic trading on candle information as a possible explanation.
ideas.quote: Positive returns of 0.58 bps per minute are disproportionately concentrated at the turn of 15-min candles (in minutes 0, 15, 30, and 45 of each trading hour).
ideas.mechanism: Possible algorithmic trading flow around 15-minute candle information; the paper describes this explanation as speculative.

rules.market: Bitcoin spot; strategy simulation on Bitfinex
rules.entry: Hold Bitcoin during minutes 0, 15, 30, and 45 of each hour; exact execution timing is not stated.
rules.exit: Exact execution timing is not stated.

ideas.claimed_result: The paper reports an average return of 0.58 basis points per turn minute in 2021 and a weaker effect in its January–August 2022 out-of-sample test.
